## policy.json + envelope.json: operator step-requirements schema (ADR-015)

### Context
rigorix-oss **ADR-015** adds operator-controlled step requirements to the sequence-policy config (`[[requirements]]` in `.rigorix/sequence-policy.toml`): a `StepPredicate` match plus `require_identity` / `require_params` obligations and a `deny`/`promote` action, evaluated at plan time for **every** plan. Engine implementation: rigorix-oss issue **#884**.

This repo is the contract source of truth for the policy/envelope shapes, so both must be reconciled (code is truth) when #884 lands.

### In scope
- `schemas/policy.json`:
  - `$defs.requirementAction`: enum `deny` | `promote` (serde lowercase).
  - `$defs.stepRequirement`: required `id`, `match` (`$ref: stepPredicate`), `action`; optional `name`, `description`, `require_identity` (bool, default false), `require_params` (array of JSON-pointer strings, default `[]`). Description notes: at least one of `require_identity`/`require_params`; pointers start with `/`; the config is operator-owned (not plan data).
  - Root: add the `requirements` array property (the serde field on `SequencePolicyConfig`).
- `schemas/envelope.json`: additive `requirement_findings` (array of `$defs.requirementFindingRef`) — `requirement_id`, `step`, `action`, `unmet` (pointer names / `"identity"`), `summary`; `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]`; parameter **values** never recorded.
- `schemas/README.md` row updates + a delta note in `docs/contract-sync-*.md`.
- `rust/rigorix-verifier`: `all_schemas_compile` covers the new schemas (no frozen-struct change unless an envelope fixture carries `requirement_findings`).

### Out of scope
- The engine behavior (issue #884).
- Enterprise bundle/ingestion (separate issue).

### DoD
- [ ] `schemas/policy.json` + `schemas/envelope.json` describe the shapes exactly as the engine serializes them (field names, serde defaults, skip-when-empty)
- [ ] README + contract-sync delta note
- [ ] `cargo test -p rigorix-verifier` green (`all_schemas_compile` + fixtures)
- [ ] rigorix-oss conformance green with the updated schemas

### References
- rigorix-oss ADR-015 · rigorix-oss issue #884 · `schemas/policy.json` · `schemas/envelope.json` · `schemas/README.md`
title: schemas: operator step-requirements in policy.json + envelope.json (ADR-015)
